svg.title: Async-RBench: configuration, runtime and response examples
svg.desc: Complete model configuration and planning command, with comments omitted. Concurrent subagents run in isolated workspaces while the main agent continues working. The scenario controller presents results under case-specific release conditions. Event evidence and the private Event Response Contract (ERC) determine DRS. Separate task-level checks determine task success S. ERCs and task checks are supplied by the external judge bundle. The trace is saved as trace.jsonl; results are saved as score.json and aggregate.json. The paper mascot illustrates three responses: retest after a new revision, handle a duplicate only once, and retry a failed subtask while preserving valid work. The illustrations are not recorded runs or measured outcomes.

g.text: Code changed? Run the tests again.
The same result twice? Keep one.
Retry failed work, keep completed work.
